name: Thomas Broadside Co.
legal: A venture of Thomas Graphics Inc., Austin, Texas
tagline: Founding documents, portraits, and maps, printed on our own press since 2026.
city_line: Austin: Printed by Thomas Graphics Inc.

house_rules.cited: Every quote carries its source, date, and document, on the product page and on the sheet. If we cannot cite it, we do not print it.
house_rules.pre_partisan: The store belongs to the founding era, not to a party. The shop's political work stays out of it.
house_rules.printed_here: Every physical print comes off our press in Austin and says so. Not print on demand, not a fulfillment warehouse.

jacob.name: Jacob E. Thomas, PhD
jacob.role: Information side. Conducts the clerks, signs the store, checks the quotes.

ben.name: Ben Thomas
ben.role: Operations and logistics. Stock, fulfillment, the trade network, the mailhouse. Holds the hands rule [D6].

david.name: David Olivo
david.role: Craft. Museum-grade production. Holds the veto [D6].

press.line: Printed on our own press in Austin, Texas
press.honest_sentence: The information side of this shop — the catalog, the letters, the ledger — is kept by machines that read; every sheet, every price, and every claim of “cited” is approved by a human being.

gate.below: The store stays a passive digital catalog with no further press runs.
gate.above: Run the full catalog, open wholesale, build the classroom line for August.

shipping.method: Rolled in a tube from Austin. Sets ship in one tube.

llm.note: Model is pinned by the LLM_MODEL environment variable in Cloudflare, never hardcoded. Pick the current Sonnet-class model from docs.claude.com and revisit quarterly.
